```{r}
#| label: irt-anova

task_anova <- read_rds(here("models/mrot_anova.rds"))
mrot_models <- task_anova |> filter(model_set == "multigroup_dataset")
```

```{r}
#| label: irt-values

mod_tbl <- mrot_models |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x))) |>
  select(-model_set, -subset)

mrot_2pl_scalar <- mod_tbl |>
  filter(itemtype == "2pl", invariance == "scalar")

mrot_2pl_configural <- mod_tbl |>
  filter(itemtype == "2pl", invariance == "configural")

mrot_rasch_scalar <- mod_tbl |>
  filter(itemtype == "rasch", invariance == "scalar")

# ΔBIC values are read off the rounded d_BIC column rather than recomputed from
# the rounded BICs, so that the figures quoted in the text match @tbl-mrot-irt.
# (Rounding each BIC before subtracting gives 416 where the table shows 417.)
delta_bic_rasch <- mrot_rasch_scalar$d_BIC
delta_bic_configural <- mrot_2pl_configural$d_BIC
bic_2pl_scalar <- as.character(mrot_2pl_scalar$BIC)
aic_2pl_scalar <- as.character(mrot_2pl_scalar$AIC)
# AIC favours the metric model even though BIC favours scalar; reported in text.
aic_2pl_metric <- mod_tbl |>
  filter(itemtype == "2pl", invariance == "metric") |> pull(AIC) |> as.character()
```
